name: Customer
definition: A commercial client holding a fuel card account, identified by CustomerID and characterized by a size Segment and a settlement Currency.
scope: Analyses of cardholder populations and of attributes attached to customers across the customer master, the transaction sample and the monthly consumption records.

name: Customer Segment
definition: Business size classification of a customer, taking the values KAM, LAM and SME.
scope: Applies only to the Segment column of the customers table. Questions mentioning 'SME', 'SMEs', 'KAM' or 'LAM' refer to this dimension.

name: Customer Settlement Currency
definition: The currency in which a customer settles, taking the values CZK (Czech koruna) and EUR (euro); it classifies customers as CZK-paying or EUR-paying.
scope: Attached to customers only. Used to split customers, and any measure joined onto them, by payment currency.

name: Gas Station
definition: A fuel retail outlet identified by GasStationID, belonging to a chain, located in a country and assigned a market segment.
scope: Analyses of retail outlets and of outlet attributes attached to purchase transactions.

name: Gas Station Country
definition: The country in which a gas station is located, coded as CZE for the Czech Republic or SVK for Slovakia.
scope: Geographic splitting of outlets and of transactions that occurred at them.

name: Gas Station Segment
definition: Market positioning category of a gas station, taking the values Discount, Noname, Other, Premium and Value for money.
scope: Applies only to the Segment column of the gasstations table. Questions mentioning 'premium' or 'discount' stations refer to this dimension.

name: Product
definition: A good or service that can be purchased at a gas station, identified by ProductID and labelled by a Description; the catalogue includes fuel, non-fuel goods and fee items.
scope: Identification of what was purchased in a transaction and of the product catalogue behind it.

name: Product Description
definition: The textual label naming a product, used when listing what was purchased.
scope: Reporting and filtering products by name. The label is not a unique key for a product.

name: Transaction
definition: A single purchase event recorded at a gas station by a card belonging to a customer, carrying a date, a time of day, a quantity and a price.
scope: Transaction-level counting, filtering and aggregation. In this database transactions are available only as the transactions_1k sample.

name: Transaction Date
definition: The calendar date on which a transaction occurred, stored as ten-character YYYY-MM-DD text.
scope: Date filtering and date-derived grouping for transactions.

name: Transaction Time
definition: The time of day at which a transaction occurred, stored as zero-padded HH:MM:SS text.
scope: Time-of-day filtering, for example restricting to a one-hour window.

name: Transaction Quantity
definition: The number of item units purchased in a transaction line; additive across lines.
scope: Quantities purchased and the denominator of per-item price measures. Zero-quantity lines exist.

name: Transaction Price
definition: The total monetary value charged for a transaction line, covering every unit in that line; additive across lines.
scope: Turnover and spending measures over transaction sets.

name: Average Price per Single Item
definition: The average price paid for one item, defined as the ratio of total price to total quantity over the selected set of transaction lines.
scope: Price-per-item reporting; only meaningful over a defined set of lines, and sensitive to zero-quantity lines.

name: Customer Total Spending
definition: The total monetary value a customer spent, obtained by summing transaction price over that customer's transaction lines.
scope: Ranking and comparing customers by spend within the available transaction sample.

name: Gas Consumption
definition: The fuel volume recorded for one customer in one month, stored as yearmonth.Consumption; additive across customers and months.
scope: Consumption analysis per customer and per month. The measurement unit is not documented in the data.

name: Consumption Period
definition: The year-and-month period of a consumption record, stored as six-character YYYYMM text.
scope: Monthly grouping and period filtering of consumption records.

name: Calendar Year
definition: A four-digit calendar year, derived from the leading four characters of either a transaction date or a consumption period.
scope: Yearly grouping and year filtering across both the transaction and the consumption tables.

name: Calendar Month
definition: The month portion of a date, derived from the month section of a transaction date or from the last two characters of a consumption period.
scope: Monthly grouping and month-of-year filtering across both temporal tables.
